blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Robin Padilla bade farewell to his “lover,” Hollywood actress-producer and philanthropist Angelina Jolie after her visit in the country. Jolie attended the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Inclusive Growth Summit in Taguig City on Wednesday, Nov. 12, as guest speaker. In a Facebook post, Padilla expressed his appreciation for Jolie’s visit in Manila. He jokingly claimed that, in his heart, they have a romantic relationship.
